qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Protected municipal concession monopolies in integrated water management, waste collection/treatment, and gas distribution in Emilia-Romagna and northern Italy. Operating tangible ROIC exceeds 25%, protected by regional municipal shareholding and ARERA regulatory tariffs.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance sheet leverage & interest coverage, REJECT). High-quality Italian multi-utility with excellent municipal management, but net debt of €3.44B represents 7.4x net income (€464M), well above the 4.0x limit. Interest coverage of 4.94x fails the 5.0x fortress requirement, with heavy ongoing capex (€1.03B vs €590M D&A) absorbing operational cash flow.
qualitative.evidence: Net debt of €3.44B (€4.29B debt less €845M cash) against FY2025 net income of €464.3M results in 7.4x leverage. EBIT of €891.3M vs interest expense of €180.5M yields 4.94x interest coverage, below the 5.0x threshold. Regulated returns structurally capped at 6-8%.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
